login.title: ACM Console Login
login.subtitle: Sign in with your admin account.
login.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Please try again later.
login.network: Cannot reach the server. Please try again.
login.locked: Your account is locked. Please contact an administrator.
login.tempExpired: Your temporary password has expired. Request a new one via “Forgot your password?”.
login.seedDisabled: The default (seed) password cannot be used in production. Ask an administrator to reissue your password.
login.keepHint: Don't tick this on a shared PC. Phones and the installed app always stay signed in.

session.expired: Your session has expired. Please sign in again.

parent.title: Parent Sign In
parent.subtitle: Receive a one-time code on your phone to sign in.
parent.otpSentNotice: A verification code has been sent.

errors.phoneInvalid: Please enter a valid phone number.
errors.otpLength: The verification code must be 6 digits.
errors.otpExpired: The code has expired. Please request a new one.
errors.tooManyAttempts: Too many attempts. Please request a new code.
errors.parentNotFound: We could not find a parent account with this number.
errors.network: Cannot reach the server. Please try again.

errors.AMA_TOKEN_EXPIRED: This sign-in link has expired. Please reopen the app from the AMA portal.
errors.AMA_TOKEN_INVALID_SIGNATURE: Invalid sign-in token. Please reopen the app from the AMA portal.
errors.AMA_TOKEN_SCOPE_INVALID: This token does not have permission to access the ACM console.
errors.AMA_TOKEN_APP_CODE_INVALID: This token was not issued for ACM.
errors.AMA_TOKEN_CLAIMS_MISSING: Sign-in token is malformed. Please contact your administrator.
errors.AMA_SSO_DISABLED: AMA sign-in is not enabled on this server.
errors.NETWORK: Cannot reach the server. Please try again.
errors.SUBSCRIPTION_SUSPENDED: Subscription is suspended. Check your billing or contact the AMA admin.
errors.SUBSCRIPTION_CANCELED: Subscription was canceled. You can re-subscribe in the AMA App Store.
errors.SUBSCRIPTION_DEPROVISIONED: This tenant has been deprovisioned. Re-subscribing will NOT restore prior data.
errors.NO_ACADEMY: This tenant is not provisioned. Activate app-academy in the AMA App Store first.
errors.NO_SUBSCRIPTION: This tenant does not have an app-academy subscription. Activate it in the AMA App Store.
errors.USER_NOT_IN_ENTITY: This user is not a member of the tenant. Ask an AMA admin to add you.
errors.AMA_UNAVAILABLE: AMA services are temporarily unreachable. Please retry shortly.

changePassword.title: Change password
changePassword.forced: For security, you must change the temporary password.
changePassword.policy: At least 8 characters, must include letters and digits.
changePassword.amaOnly: Accounts that sign in with AMA manage their password in AMA.

forgot.title: Forgot password
forgot.desc: Enter your email and a reset request will be sent to your administrator, who will email you a temporary password.
forgot.done: Your request has been received. If the account exists, an administrator will email you a temporary password.
forgot.rateLimited: Too many requests. Please try again later.
forgot.failed: Could not send the request. Please try again later.

temp.confirmDesc: The current password stops working immediately. The temporary password is valid for 24 hours and must be changed after signing in.
temp.mailSent: The temporary password was sent to {{email}}.
temp.mailNotSent: Mail is not configured or could not be sent. Give the temporary password below to the user directly.
temp.onceOnly: It cannot be shown again after you close this window.
temp.inactive: Cannot issue for an inactive account.
temp.failed: Could not issue a temporary password.

requests.title: Password reset requests
requests.desc: Requests from 'Forgot password' on the sign-in page. Verify the person, then issue a temporary password.
requests.alreadyHandled: This request has already been handled.

lock.account: Too many failed sign-ins — this account is locked for now. Try again after {{time}} or contact an administrator.
lock.ip: Too many failed sign-ins from this location — temporarily blocked. Try again after {{time}}.
